record.label: SUB-1: engine plane emission retrofitted into the card
record.summary: Teammate A (fork 'emission-retrofit'): term-level diff of the engine's validated emission_K21 (Mehler stack + Edgeworth on m,v,k3,k4,C,K21,K22,K31) vs the card's _gaussian_pair -> _connected_planes + _cp_post_read; retrofit into a COPY of the card (public_g20_emission_retrofit_v1), certified per term; raw on r35/r100 with F2J on/off; billed-flop delta. Prices mechanism leaves N1.2a/N1.2b (P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2A_EMISSION, _N1_2B_PUSHREAD) and N4. RESULT (T-25/T-28, public_g20_emission_retrofit_v1): emission null; mechanism = carried pushed residual; in-card carry is net-negative with F2J on and +17% util; realizing it needs F2J refit + a >=3x cheaper carrier (rank, not rows). Closed as measured.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when raw delta and bill delta are measured on both nets with F2J on/off (either a deployable gain at ~zero cost, or a coadaptation loss with per-layer plane accuracies reported for SUB-2).
record.goal_path_summary: Test whether dropping the engine's better per-layer correlation formula straight into the estimator makes it more accurate for free - or whether the estimator's other parts, tuned around the old formula, fight the change.
